findings.message: dep-unselected is not analyzed from source here, so the behaviour of imported export useThing is unknown; solid-checker cannot tell whether it reads reactive values, takes tracked callbacks, or returns accessors, so code flowing through it cannot be certified
findings.hint: Installed Solid packages are analyzed from their runtime source when the run declares a runtime target and build (--runtime-target, --runtime-build) and a Solid Vite plugin resolves from the project, or when --dependency-source names them. A package source analysis cannot read stays uncertifiable.

findings.message: useContext is called without a reactive owner; Solid throws NoOwnerError ("Context can only be accessed under a reactive root.") here, so the read never returns a value; this call runs it inside a package analyzed as source, under this call's owner context
findings.hint: Read the context while a component, or a computation it creates, is being set up, and pass the value to the handler, timer or callback that needs it. A handler, a timer, a module-scope statement and code after an await run with no owner. The operation is in the package; give this call an owner (call it in a component or computation, or under createRoot).
